title: Kasturi Nivasa
desc: Ravi, the owner of a matchbox factory, decides to support Chandru financially and sends him to the US for training. Things take a turn when he returns and suggests changing the company's structure.

title: Hasy Darbar
desc: People take turns to tell jokes, recount hilarious anecdotes and perform humorous skits as they participate in a thought-provoking debate.

title: Roshagara
desc: A vigilante constantly blackmails a corrupt businessman. His hidden motive is soon revealed when he kidnaps the businessman's daughter upon her arrival in the country.

title: Bandhana
desc: Harish, a doctor, falls in love with Nandini, his student. However, he slips into depression when he confesses his feelings for her and learns that she is marrying her childhood friend, Balu.

title: Nagavalli Vs Apthamithraru
desc: A group of friends sets out on a journey to find out about the existence of Nagavalli, the ghost of a dancer, who is rumoured to be the cause of deaths and illnesses in the Kannada film industry.
